    CHAOSS metrics

    Source: vignettes/chaoss-metrics.Rmd
    chaoss-metrics.Rmd

    The repometrics package collates many metrics of a nominated repository, including the metrics defined by the CHAOSS community (“Community Health Analytics in Open Source Software”). The metrics implemented by this package can be seen by first loading the package:

    library (repometrics)

    And the calling this function:

    rm_metrics_list ()

    That returns a data.frame with two columns, rendered here in hyperlinked form:

    As noted in the documentation for the rm_metrics_list function:

    Metrics have been adapted in this package, and so may not precisely reflect the descriptions provided in the CHAOSS community web pages linked to in the URLs from this function. Adaptations have in particular been implemented to align metrics with their usage in aggregate “models”.

    All metrics are collated by calling the main repometrics_data() function.
